scope: EVAL-010 frozen 30-50 case corpus admission, frozen manifest digest, immutable artifact hashing, independent oracle review and hard oracle-isolation gate
non_compensable_gates: exact manifest SHA-256 matches frozen digest
every benchmark case belongs to the frozen corpus when catalog supplied
benchmark oracle reference/hash matches frozen manifest
no generation-context evidence references an oracle artifact
no generation-context evidence references an oracle-review artifact
decision_rule: all non-compensable admission and isolation gates must pass per case; failures cannot be averaged away
later_treatment_tie_rule: NO_CLEAR_WINNER when pre-specified measurements do not distinguish candidates without unresolved tradeoff
explicit_nonclaims: no real 30-50 case corpus is bundled by this gate
no oracle quality is claimed before reviewed oracle artifacts are supplied
no retrieval or generation treatment selection
no exact-head PASS until executable evidence exists
